Istilahi Muhimu:
Mandhari,
Uyakinifu,
Uhusika, Mhusika.
Mandhari hufasiliwa kuwa ni wakati na mahali patendekapo kadhia, visa au matukio katika utungo wa kifasihi unaohusika.
Mandhari yanaweza kuwa halisi au ya kufikirika.
Utafiti ulioichipuza makala hii uliazimia kuchunguza usawiri wa mandhari katika riwaya ya Mohamed S. Mohamed, Kiu pamoja na ile ya Ken Walibora, Kidagaa Kimwemwozea.
Ingawa malengo muhsusi ya utafiti yalikuwa matatu, makala hii inazamia lengo moja tu - kutathmini mchango wa mandhari katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea.
Tathmini yenyewe imekitwa kwenye mseto wa nadharia mbili - Uhalisia na Umuundo.
Nadharia ya Uhalisia inachimuza uyakinifu wa mandhari ya kijamii ilhali nadharia ya Umuundo ikasisitiza dhima na uhusiano wa vipengele vya sanaa.
Utafiti huu wenye mkabala wa kithamano ulifanywa maktabani kwa kuzingatia muundo wa kiuchanganuzi.
Eneo la utafiti ni fasihi andishi, hususan utanzu wa riwaya ya Kiswahili.
Idadi lengwa ya utafiti ni riwaya 10 za kiuhalisia zinazosawiri mandhari halisi.
Sampuli ya riwaya mbili, Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea, iliteuliwa kwa usampulishaji dhaminifu.
Riwaya hizi ziliteuliwa kwa misingi ya wingi wa vifani vilivyochunguzwa, yaani usawiri wa mandhari.
Pamoja na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, utunzi wa riwaya teule unaambatana na mihimili ya mseto wa nadharia za utafiti.
Data msingi ya utafiti ilikusanywa kwa usomaji wa kina wa matini za riwaya teule.
Nazo data za upili zikakusanywa kwa usomaji wa kina wa vitabu, tasnifu na makala anuwai za kitaaluma.
Data zilizokusanywa ziliainishwa kwa mujibu wa mihimili ya nadharia na malengo ya utafiti.
Zilichanganuliwa kwa mujibu wa yaliyomo na matokeo kuwasilishwa kimaelezo.
Matokeo ya utafiti yanadhihirisha kwamba mandhari yana mchango wa moja kwa moja katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika.
Mandhari hayo ni kama vile: ya mahali(upembeni mwa Mto Kiberenge, chumba cha Mtemi Nasaba Bora, msituni, seli, chumba cha Mzee Mwinyi na mandhari ya mitaa kama wa vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele na mingineyo) na ya kiwakati (enzi za kikoloni,miaka mitano, Vitaa Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia na kadhalika).
Mandhari haya yalisukwa kwa ustadi ambao ulichangia ukuzaji wa sifa za wahusika kwa urahisi mno.

UTANGULIZI
Kazi ya kifasihi hujengwa kwa vipengele anuwai vya fani, yakiwemo matumizi ya mandhari.
Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia ujenzi na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi.
Mandhari aghalabu hutumiwa na mwanafasihi kuwasilishia ujumbe wake kwa msomaji.
Kipengele cha mandhari kimefafanuliwa na wataalamu mbalimbali.
Mathalan, Wamitila (2008) anaeleza mandhari kuwa ni elementi inayomfichulia msomaji ni wapi na lini kadhia au matukio fulani yalitendeka.
Mandhari yanaweza kuwa na uhalisia au yawe hayana uhalisia bali ni ya kidhahania.
Mandhari ya uhalisia yanahusu mahali ambapo panapatikana katika ulimwengu halisi.
Kwa mfano, mandhari ya msitu, chuoni, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini na maabadini.
Mandhari ya kidhahania yanahusu mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi huonekana kupitia ruya.
Mfano wa mandhari ya kidhahania ni peponi, kuzimu na jahanamu.
Mandhari anayochorewa msomaji husalia akilini mwake.
Waandishi wengi wanapotunga kazi zao huziweka katika mandhari tofauti tofauti kwa sababu ya kutosheleza madhumuni mbalimbali kifasihi na kisanaa.
Inajuzu kusema kwamba mandhari ni mhimili mkuu katika tungo za kisanaa.
Mandhari huathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi ikiwemo kumpa taswira anuwai ya yale ambayo mwandishi alikusudia kuyawasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022).
Taswira hizi zinaweza kuwa kama vile: taswira oni, inayompa uwezo wa ‘kuona’ kile ambacho mwandishi anamchorea kwa maneno, taswira mwendo ambayo itamsaidia kupata tukio ‘kimwendo’ kwa mujibu wa mandhari ambamo tukio linatokea, taswira hisi ambapo atapata hisia mbalimbali za wahusika katika eneo la tungo jinsi mwandishi alivyochimuza hisia hizo, taswira mwonjo, ambayo msomaji huipata katika mandhari ambamo kitendo au vitendo vinavyoibua hisia ya kutonesha mate huibuliwa na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira sikivu.

Tukichukulia mfano wa eneo la Selea ambalo liko kwenye riwaya ya Kiu tunaelezwa na mwandishi kwamba lilikuwa ni eneo (mandhari) ambalo lilikuwa na umaskini mwingi, shida nazo zilikuwa kemkem, wenyeji waliishi kwenye vibanda na wengine vyumba vilivyokandikwa kwa udongo, barabara yenyewe ya kufikia huko ilikuwa mbovu kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halingefikia.
Wahusika kama Bahati na Mamake Chausiku walioishi katika mtaa huu walikuwa maskini vilevile.
Hii ina maana kuwa mazingira yale yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa hawa wahusika na sifa zao.
Walikuwa maskini ndiyo maana wakaishi pale.
Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mandhari yanafahamisha kuhusu safari ya mhusika kuanzia mwanzo wake hadi mwisho kwenye hadithi.
Kwa hivyo, msomaji hupata kumwelewa mhusika katika kila eneo kisifa katika kila hatua.
Mfano mzuri ni wa mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu kwenye riwaya Kidagaa Kimemwozea ambaye tunaambiwa kuhusu utoto wake, kusoma kwake hadi ng’ambo, kuingilia ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria vipindi vyake shuleni Nasaba Bora, kuachishwa kazi na kupata nyingine, kuingilia wizi wa miswada ya waandishi na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipoalikwa Wangwani.
Hapa inatupatia sifa kadhaa za huyu mhusika kupitia mandhari mbalimbali kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa taaluma na mtepetevu kazini.
Sifa za wahusika aghalabu huchangia kumtambua na kumpambanua mhusika fulani kwa urahisi.
Sifa hizi mara nyingi hubainisha uraibu wake, mienendo au hata hulka yake kwenye kazi ya fasihi inayohusika.
Kwa hali hiyo, mandhari huwa na michango maridhawa katika kusawiri wahusika kisifa (Wamitila, 2002).
Kwa kiasi kikubwa wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanamosawiriwa.
Baadhi ya kazi za kifasihi husawiri mandhari ya umaskini, shida kemkem na wahusika wanaoishi kwenye vibanda na vyumba vilivyokandikwa kwa udongo pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu.
Hii ina maana kwamba mandhari yanayosawiriwa na msanii yana athari ya moja kwa moja kwa ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika wa sanaa inayohusika.
Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti ulioizalisha makala hii.
Azma kuu ilikuwa ni kuchunguza usawiri wa mandhari kwenye riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea ili kubainisha uhusiano uliopo baina ya mandhari na sifa za wahusika.
Kwa njia ya tathmini, hoja inayojengwa na makala hii ni kwamba mandhari wanamojikuta wahusika katika riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea yana mchango kwa ujenzi wa sifa zao.
Imethibitika kwamba mandhari pia yanachangia namna ambavyo wahusika fulani wanasawiriwa.
Mandhari yana uamilifu adhimu katika kuwapa wahusika sifa fulani (Wamitila, 2002).
Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta hudokeza na huathiri usawiri wa sifa zake.
Kwa hivyo makala hii inautalii uhusiano uliopo baina ya mandhari na sifa za wahusika kwenye tungo hizi mbili na kubainika wazi kwamba upo huo uhusiano na jinsi hawa watunzi walivyowasawiri wahusika wao.
MWAUO WA MAANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kwamba mandhari huwa na michango maridhawa katika kusawiri wahusika kisifa.
Anaeleza kwamba kwa kiasi kikubwa wahusika huathiriwa na mazingira ambamo wamo.
Hili dai la Wamitila lilijitokeza katika huu utafiti.
Ili kusawiri mhusika kwa njia fulani, jambo la msingi ni kuchunguza mandhari alimo (Wamitila, 2008).
Dai hili liliafikiwa na huu utafiti pale ambapo mhusika kama Majununi aliangaziwa sifa zake kwenye riwaya Kidagaa Kimemwozea, tulipata kwamba mhusika huyu alitumiwa na mwandishi ili kutujuza kuhusu kipindi fulani cha kihistoria ambacho ni Vita Vikuu Vya Dunia vya Pili na kwamba Majununi alikuwa miongoni mwa wanajeshi wa Uingereza waliopigana katika vita hivi, watu wengi wakafa katika uwanja wa vita lakini yeye akaponea.

Hivyo, basi asemavyo Wamitila (2008) kila mhusika hupata sifa zinazooana na mandhari alimo ni madai ya kweli na yalisaidia katika kupata jibu la swali la utafiti kwamba mandhari huchangia katika kukuza sifa za wahusika.

Kwa hivyo, tukichunguza baadhi ya fasiri za wataalamu hawa tunapata kwamba walijikita katika mandhari ya maeneo na wakati katika fasiri zao.
Fasiri ambazo zilichangia pakubwa katika utafiti huu kwa maana utafiti wenyewe ulichunguza mandhari kwa kuegemea katika dhana kwamba mandhari ni wakati na mahali ambapo matukio ya kisanii hutendeka.
MISINGI YA KINADHARIA
Kupitia kwa mhimili wa pili wa nadharia ya Uhalisia, utafiti huu ulichunguza jinsi waandishi wa vitabu hivi teule walivyosawiri hali halisi katika tungo zao kupitia mandhari mbalimbali walizotumia ili kutuwezesha kubaini baadhi ya sifa za wahusika mbalimbali na hivyo kutusaidia katika kuafiki lengo la utafiti huu ambalo ni kutathmini mchango wa mandhari katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea.
Mihimili ya mseto wa nadharia mbili ndiyo iliyouongozwa utafiti huu.
Yaani, nadharia ya Uhalisia na nadharia ya Umuundo.
Nadharia ya Uhalisia ilichipuka kunako karne ya kumi na tisa (Ntarangwi, 2004).
Istilahi ‘uhalisia’ ni tafsiri la neno la Kiingereza ‘realism’ lililotumiwa awali kurejelea tawi la falsafa linalojihusisha na masuala yanayohusika na milango ya fahamu ya binadamu.
Hivi sasa neno hili linatumiwa kurejelea fahiwa mbili, ya kwanza ikiwa ni ile inayotathmini hali ya maisha, yaani hali halisi ya fasihi inayoashiria kipawa cha utunzi na kuelezea matukio kwa mujibu wa uyakinifu; nayo fahiwa ya pili ikiwa hali halisi ya maisha ya binadamu.
Nadharia ya Umuundo aghalabu huhusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005).
Inasisitiza vipengele vya kazi ya sanaa kama vile msuko, ujumbe, wahusika, muktadha, lugha na jinsi ambavyo vinahusiana hadi kuikamilisha kazi inayohusika.
Nadharia hii inachunguza uhusiano uliopo baina ya vipengee vingi vya tungo za fasihi kama vile uhakiki wa usimulizi kimuundo.
Nadharia hii huzingatia usimulizi wa kazi ya sanaa.
Kwa mfano, uhakiki wa riwaya kimuundo huzingatia riwaya kama kazi inayojitosheleza na iliyo na vipengele vya kimuundo kama vile msuko, wahusika na mbinu mbalimbali za usimulizi ambazo huingiliana na kutegemeana.

Mihimili ya nadharia ya Umuundo ni pamoja na:
• Waandishi na wahakiki wa kiuhalisia wanachukulia kwamba jukumu la mtunzi liwe kusawiri ukweli unavyojitokeza katika jamii husika.
• Kazi yoyote ya fasihi ina muundo unaojitosheleza katika sehemu zake mbalimbali zinazohusiana na kuungana ili kuunda mfumo mmoja mkamilifu (ploti).
• Wanauhalisia waliamini kuwa mwandishi alihitajika kutoa picha kamili ya jamii yake jinsi ilivyo bila kuidunisha wala kuipigia chuku.

Kwa hivyo, mhimili wa kwanza wa nadharia ya Umuundo ulitusaidia kubaini jinsi mandhari yanavyochangia kuibua vipengele muhimu vya ploti pamoja na sifa za wahusika mbalimbali katika riwaya teule zilizochambuliwa.
METHODOLOJIA YA UTAFITI
wa data za utafiti huu ulifanywa kwa mujibu wa yaliyomo ili kubaini aina mbalimbali za mandhari kwenye riwaya teule na michango yao katika ukuzaji wa sifa za wahusika mbalimbali kwenye riwaya hizi.
Kufuatia uchanganuzi wa data, matokeo ya utafiti yamewasilishwa kwa njia ya maelezo.
Ufafanuzi wenyewe umetekelezwa kwa mujibu wa malengo na mihimili ya mseto wa nadharia zilizoongoza uchunguzi.
Maelezo ni njia ya uchambuzi imwidhinishayo mtafiti kusoma au kusikiliza kazi ya fasihi, kufahamu maudhui, mitazamo ya kifalsafa ya kazi inayohusika, miongoni mwa mengine muhimu (Adam, 2014).
MANDHARI YAJENGAVYO SIFA ZA WAHUSIKA WA RIWAYA YA KIUHALISIA
Mandhari yana uamilifu adhimu katika kuwapa wahusika sifa fulani (Wamitila, 2002).
Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta hudokeza na huathiri usawiri wa sifa zake.
Utafiti huu wenye mkabala wa kithamano ulijikita katika muundo wa utafiti wa kiuchanganuzi.
Utafiti wa kiuchanganuzi huchunguza kwa undani vigeu ili kufikia uamuzi ufaao (Read, 1987).
Muundo huu ulituwezesha kukusanya, kuchambua na kueleza matokeo kwa mujibu wa yale yaliyotokana na utafiti huu hivyo basi kutusaidia kufikia uamuzi ufaao.
Mbili katika idadi lengwa ya riwaya 10 za kiuhalisia ziliteuliwa kwa usampulishaji dhaminifu.
Huu ni usampulishaji sinasibu ambapo sampuli huteuliwa kwa misingi ya upekee wa sifa za zinazohitajika kwenye utafiti.
Usampulishaji dhaminifu aghalabu huhusu uteuzi wa kundi wakilishi la watafitiwa, vitu au dhana zinazosadifu vigeu vya utafiti vinavyochunguzwa (Kombo & Tromp, 2006).
Kwa hivyo, riwaya teule ziliafikiana na malengo pamoja na mihimili ya nadharia za utafiti na ndiyo maana zikateuliwa kwa makusudi hayo.
Sifa za wahusika aghalabu huchangia kumtambua na kumpambanua mhusika fulani kwa urahisi, hizi sifa mara nyingi hubainisha uraibu wake, mienendo au hata hulka yake kwenye kazi ya fasihi inayohusika.
Chukulia kwa mfano kwenye Kiu mazingira ya nyumbani kwake Mzee Mwinyi imesawiriwa kwa namna ya kwamba chumba chake kilikuwa na zulia na pambo la thamani.
Zaidi ya hayo alimiliki gari aina ya benzi hii inaashiria kwamba alikuwa na mali nyingi sana hivyo basi kuwa bwanyenye.
Vijisehemu vifuatavyo vimetumiwa kuchanganua na kujadili riwaya moja baada ya nyingine, tukianza na ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika Kidagaa Kimemwozea.
Mandhari Yajengavyo Sifa za Wahusika wa Kidagaa Kimemwozea
Data msingi ya utafiti ilikusanywa kwa usomaji wa kina wa riwaya teule.
Usomaji wa kina hujumuisha mikakati kama vile kupigia mistari maneno yasiyoyofahamika, kudondoa hoja muhimu, kunakili mawazo yatokanayo kisomwacho, kuandika maswali, kuchunguza uhusiano au uingiliano matini pamoja na dhima ya msimulizi (Rief, 2012).
Riwaya za Kiu pamoja na Kidagaa Kimwemwozea zilichambuliwa na kufafanuliwa ili kuyafanikisha malengo ya utafiti.Isitoshe, makala, majarida, tasnifu na machapisho mengine kuhusu suala la utafiti yalisomwa na kuchangia upatikanaji wa data za upili.
Mandhari yanamchango mkubwa katika kukuza sifa za wahusika kwa vile jinsi ambavyo mtunzi anavyosawiri mandhari yake yatasaidia msomaji kuelewa mengi kuhusu tabia, mienendo na hata hali yake katika tungo zinazowasiliswa na waandishi wa kazi husika.

Uchafu unaozungumziwa hapa umetumika kisitiari kwa maana kwamba Mtemi Nasaba Bora alikuwa mwovu.
Mtemi alitenda maovu mengi kama kuua Chichiri Hamadi na kumwibia mamake Imani shamba lake na hivyo basi alitaka matendo haya yafichike na yeyote aliyetaka kuyaangazia alipata vitisho, kifo na hata kufutwa kazi.
Jinsi alivyowafuta kazi wafanyikazi wake waliojaribu kulinadhifisha kasri lake.
Kwa hivyo, uchafu wa kasri lile na kuishi kwa Mtemi Nasaba Bora katika kasri hilo kunaoana vyema na tabia zake chafu chafu (maovu) jinsi zinavyojitokeza kwenye riwaya hii.
sehemu inayofuata kupitia wahusika kadhaa kama vile: Mtemi Nasaba Bora akiwa nyumbani kwake tunamwona akiwa mwenye mapuuza na hasira, maegeshoni akidhihirisha mapuuza na sehemu nyinginezo kama msituni ambapo anachimuza sifa ya mtamaushi, Dj akiwa kando ya Mto Kiberenge amesawiriwa kama mtamaduni.
Mwalimu Majisifu akiwa kwake ameonyeshwa kuwa mlevi na Mkokotoni akisawiriwa kama mwoga, Dora nyumbani kwake amejitokeza kama mwajibikaji, Amani kwenye chumba chake amesawiriwa kama mvumilivu naye Imani kwa mwalimu Majisifu amechorwa kama mwenye utu na mapenzi ya dhati, askari kwenye seli ya Mtemi Nasaba Bora wanachimuza sifa ya kuwa katili na zuhura kwake anaibua sifa ya mwenye utu na mapenzi ya dhati.
Mtemi Nasaba Bora
Kwenye mandhari ya ukumbi wa Kasri la Mtemi Nasaba Bora, tunachorewa taswira ya makochi yayoachwa na Majununi yakiwa yamechanikachanika.
Barabara ya kuelekea huko kwenye kasri pia inadhihirishwa kuwa ni mbovu.
Nyumba yenyewe nayo imeandikwa andikwa kwenye kuta na wanawe Mtemi.
Tunasimuliwa,
Mtemi Nasaba Bora ndiye mhusika mkuu katika riwaya ya Kidagaa Kimemwozea.
Ndiye kiongozi wa eneo la Sokomoko au Mtemi kama anavyojulikana miongoni mwa Wanasokomoko.

ABSTRACT
Date of Publication:
07 July 2025
Key Terms:
Setting,
Realism,
Characterization, Character. Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined. The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements. This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings. A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling. These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels. Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study. They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits. These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on). These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits. The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars. For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell. The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions. Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery. Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it. Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there. Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development. A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work. Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work. In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work. This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The objectives of the study were guided by the combination of two theories, namely, the theory of Realism and the theory of Structuralism. The theory of Realism emerged in the nineteenth century (Ntarangwi, 2004). The term 'uhalisia' is a translation of the English word 'realism', which was originally used to refer to a branch of philosophy concerned with matters related to human perception. Currently, this term is used to refer to two meanings: the first is one that evaluates the state of life, that is, the reality in literature which signifies the skill of composition and describes events according to objectivity; and the second meaning is the actual condition of human life. The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). It emphasizes the elements of an artistic work such as plot, message, characters, context, language, and how these interact to complete the work in question. This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other. discourses.translated_txt: Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined.

discourses.translated_txt: The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements.

UTANGULIZI
Kazi ya kifasihi hujengwa kwa vipengele anuwai vya fani, yakiwemo matumizi ya mandhari. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia ujenzi na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Mandhari aghalabu hutumiwa na mwanafasihi kuwasilishia ujumbe wake kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha mandhari kimefafanuliwa na wataalamu mbalimbali.
discourses.translated_txt:
INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars.

discourses.source_txt: Mathalan, Wamitila (2008) anaeleza mandhari kuwa ni elementi inayomfichulia msomaji ni wapi na lini kadhia au matukio fulani yalitendeka. Mandhari yanaweza kuwa na uhalisia au yawe hayana uhalisia bali ni ya kidhahania. Mandhari ya uhalisia yanahusu mahali ambapo panapatikana katika ulimwengu halisi. Kwa mfano, mandhari ya msitu, chuoni, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini na maabadini. Mandhari ya kidhahania yanahusu mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi huonekana kupitia ruya. Mfano wa mandhari ya kidhahania ni peponi, kuzimu na jahanamu.
discourses.translated_txt: For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell.

discourses.source_txt: Mandhari anayochorewa msomaji husalia akilini mwake. Waandishi wengi wanapotunga kazi zao huziweka katika mandhari tofauti tofauti kwa sababu ya kutosheleza madhumuni mbalimbali kifasihi na kisanaa. Inajuzu kusema kwamba mandhari ni mhimili mkuu katika tungo za kisanaa.
discourses.translated_txt: The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions.

discourses.source_txt: Mandhari huathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi ikiwemo kumpa taswira anuwai ya yale ambayo mwandishi alikusudia kuyawasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Taswira hizi zinaweza kuwa kama vile: taswira oni, inayompa uwezo wa ‘kuona’ kile ambacho mwandishi anamchorea kwa maneno, taswira mwendo ambayo itamsaidia kupata tukio ‘kimwendo’ kwa mujibu wa mandhari ambamo tukio linatokea, taswira hisi ambapo atapata hisia mbalimbali za wahusika katika eneo la tungo jinsi mwandishi alivyochimuza hisia hizo, taswira mwonjo, ambayo msomaji huipata katika mandhari ambamo kitendo au vitendo vinavyoibua hisia ya kutonesha mate huibuliwa na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira sikivu.
discourses.translated_txt: Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery.

Tukichukulia mfano wa eneo la Selea ambalo liko kwenye riwaya ya Kiu tunaelezwa na mwandishi kwamba lilikuwa ni eneo (mandhari) ambalo lilikuwa na umaskini mwingi, shida nazo zilikuwa kemkem, wenyeji waliishi kwenye vibanda na wengine vyumba vilivyokandikwa kwa udongo, barabara yenyewe ya kufikia huko ilikuwa mbovu kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halingefikia.
discourses.translated_txt: Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it.

discourses.source_txt: Wahusika kama Bahati na Mamake Chausiku walioishi katika mtaa huu walikuwa maskini vilevile. Hii ina maana kuwa mazingira yale yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa hawa wahusika na sifa zao. Walikuwa maskini ndiyo maana wakaishi pale.
discourses.translated_txt: Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mandhari yanafahamisha kuhusu safari ya mhusika kuanzia mwanzo wake hadi mwisho kwenye hadithi. Kwa hivyo, msomaji hupata kumwelewa mhusika katika kila eneo kisifa katika kila hatua.
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development.

discourses.source_txt: Mfano mzuri ni wa mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu kwenye riwaya Kidagaa Kimemwozea ambaye tunaambiwa kuhusu utoto wake, kusoma kwake hadi ng’ambo, kuingilia ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria vipindi vyake shuleni Nasaba Bora, kuachishwa kazi na kupata nyingine, kuingilia wizi wa miswada ya waandishi na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipoalikwa Wangwani. Hapa inatupatia sifa kadhaa za huyu mhusika kupitia mandhari mbalimbali kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa taaluma na mtepetevu kazini.
discourses.translated_txt: A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work.

discourses.source_txt: Sifa za wahusika aghalabu huchangia kumtambua na kumpambanua mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Sifa hizi mara nyingi hubainisha uraibu wake, mienendo au hata hulka yake kwenye kazi ya fasihi inayohusika.
discourses.translated_txt: Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work.

discourses.source_txt: Kwa hali hiyo, mandhari huwa na michango maridhawa katika kusawiri wahusika kisifa (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi kikubwa wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanamosawiriwa. Baadhi ya kazi za kifasihi husawiri mandhari ya umaskini, shida kemkem na wahusika wanaoishi kwenye vibanda na vyumba vilivyokandikwa kwa udongo pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu. Hii ina maana kwamba mandhari yanayosawiriwa na msanii yana athari ya moja kwa moja kwa ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika wa sanaa inayohusika.
discourses.translated_txt: In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work.

discourses.source_txt:
Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti ulioizalisha makala hii. Azma kuu ilikuwa ni kuchunguza usawiri wa mandhari kwenye riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea ili kubainisha uhusiano uliopo baina ya mandhari na sifa za wahusika. Kwa njia ya tathmini, hoja inayojengwa na makala hii ni kwamba mandhari wanamojikuta wahusika katika riwaya ya Kiu na Kidagaa Kimemwozea yana mchango kwa ujenzi wa sifa zao. Imethibitika kwamba mandhari pia yanachangia namna ambavyo wahusika fulani wanasawiriwa. Mandhari yana uamilifu adhimu katika kuwapa wahusika sifa fulani (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta hudokeza na huathiri usawiri wa sifa zake. Kwa hivyo makala hii inautalii uhusiano uliopo baina ya mandhari na sifa za wahusika kwenye tungo hizi mbili na kubainika wazi kwamba upo huo uhusiano na jinsi hawa watunzi walivyowasawiri wahusika wao. MWAUO WA MAANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kwamba mandhari huwa na michango maridhawa katika kusawiri wahusika kisifa. Anaeleza kwamba kwa kiasi kikubwa wahusika huathiriwa na mazingira ambamo wamo. Hili dai la Wamitila lilijitokeza katika huu utafiti. Ili kusawiri mhusika kwa njia fulani, jambo la msingi ni kuchunguza mandhari alimo (Wamitila, 2008).
discourses.translated_txt:
This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

WRITING STYLE
Wamitila (2002) states that setting makes substantial contributions to the depiction of character traits. He explains that characters are largely influenced by their surroundings. This assertion by Wamitila emerged in this research. In order to depict a character in a particular way, it is essential to examine the setting in which they are found (Wamitila, 2008).

discourses.source_txt: Dai hili liliafikiwa na huu utafiti pale ambapo mhusika kama Majununi aliangaziwa sifa zake kwenye riwaya Kidagaa Kimemwozea, tulipata kwamba mhusika huyu alitumiwa na mwandishi ili kutujuza kuhusu kipindi fulani cha kihistoria ambacho ni Vita Vikuu Vya Dunia vya Pili na kwamba Majununi alikuwa miongoni mwa wanajeshi wa Uingereza waliopigana katika vita hivi, watu wengi wakafa katika uwanja wa vita lakini yeye akaponea.
discourses.translated_txt: This claim was affirmed by this research when the character Majununi was examined in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. We found that this character was used by the author to inform us about a specific historical period, which is the Second World War, and that Majununi was among the British soldiers who fought in this war. Many people died on the battlefield, but he survived.

Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

Nadharia hii inachunguza uhusiano uliopo baina ya vipengee vingi vya tungo za fasihi kama vile uhakiki wa usimulizi kimuundo. Nadharia hii huzingatia usimulizi wa kazi ya sanaa. Kwa mfano, uhakiki wa riwaya kimuundo huzingatia riwaya kama kazi inayojitosheleza na iliyo na vipengele vya kimuundo kama vile msuko, wahusika na mbinu mbalimbali za usimulizi ambazo huingiliana na kutegemeana.
discourses.translated_txt: The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). It emphasizes the elements of an artistic work such as plot, message, characters, context, language, and how these interact to complete the work in question. This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other.

discourses.translated_txt: Constructing causal scenarios: The setting—both geographical and historical—intertwines with and enhances the characteristics of the characters in narrated stories.
